svg.title: GateX system architecture
svg.desc: People use a dashboard in the browser, which calls the GateX server. The server runs the GateX engine, which freezes the file, counts in code, has three AI Examiners mark it independently, lets a Final reviewer compare their marks, and decides green, amber or red by a fixed rule. The engine uses adapters for the file reader, model services, reports and Postgres.
